mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SOCIAL_USER (ID, NAME, EMAIL, GENDER, BIRTHDAY, MOBILE, MEMBER_TYPE, CREATED_DATE, MODIFIED_DATE, AUTH_VENDOR, ROLE) VALUES (SOCIAL_USER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{email}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{mobile}, #{memberType}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{authVendor}, #{role})
mapper.update: UPDATE SOCIAL_USER SET GENDER = #{gender}, BIRTHDAY = #{birthday}, MOBILE = #{mobile}, MEMBER_TYPE = #{memberType}, MODIFIED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE NAME = #{name} AND EMAIL = #{email} AND AUTH_VENDOR = #{authVendor}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, NAME, EMAIL, GENDER, BIRTHDAY, MOBILE, MEMBER_TYPE, CREATED_DATE AS "createdDate", MODIFIED_DATE AS "modifiedDate", AUTH_VENDOR AS "authVendor", ROLE FROM SOCIAL_USER WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND AUTH_VENDOR = #{authVendor}
